set -e
TOK=$(cat ~/.cache/huggingface/token)
mkdir -p /workspace/gt
curl -sfL -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" -o /tmp/gt-flight-03.tar.gz https://huggingface.co/datasets/miguelemosreverte/alambique-datasets/resolve/main/scenes/kazbek-run-c10-gt/gt-flight-03.tar.gz && tar xzf /tmp/gt-flight-03.tar.gz -C /workspace/gt && rm /tmp/gt-flight-03.tar.gz

curl -sfL -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" -o /tmp/gt-flight-03-look-right.tar.gz https://huggingface.co/datasets/miguelemosreverte/alambique-datasets/resolve/main/scenes/kazbek-run-c10-gt/gt-flight-03-look-right.tar.gz && tar xzf /tmp/gt-flight-03-look-right.tar.gz -C /workspace/gt && rm /tmp/gt-flight-03-look-right.tar.gz

curl -sfL -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" -o /tmp/gt-flight-03-look-down.tar.gz https://huggingface.co/datasets/miguelemosreverte/alambique-datasets/resolve/main/scenes/kazbek-run-c10-gt/gt-flight-03-look-down.tar.gz && tar xzf /tmp/gt-flight-03-look-down.tar.gz -C /workspace/gt && rm /tmp/gt-flight-03-look-down.tar.gz
python3 /workspace/pod-runtime/pod/build_gt_index.py /workspace/scenes/kazbek-run-c10/sparse/0 /workspace/gt /workspace/neural-landscape/public/flights/flight-03.json
python3 /workspace/pod-runtime/pod/make_dense_init.py /workspace/scenes/kazbek-run-c10 /workspace/gt /workspace/neural-landscape/public/flights/flight-03.json --cap 4000000
python3 /workspace/pod-runtime/pod/apply_gt_dense_depth.py /workspace/gsplat
cd /workspace/gsplat && python3 examples/simple_trainer_2dgs.py \
  --data-dir /workspace/scenes/kazbek-run-c10 --data-factor 1 \
  --result-dir /workspace/results/gsplat_kazbek-run-s1-surfel \
  --max-steps 60000 --normal-loss --sh-degree 1 --disable-viewer
echo RUN-S1-DONE
